lessons.title: Reading a Wiring Diagram
lessons.summary: Learn to trace circuits and spot common wiring faults before they become expensive repairs.

questions.prompt: On a standard wiring diagram, a broken line typically indicates:
Which symbol usually represents a fuse?
options: A rectangle with a line through it

lessons.title: Torque Spec Fundamentals
lessons.summary: Why torque specs matter, and what happens when a fastener is over- or under-torqued.

questions.prompt: Over-torquing a fastener most commonly leads to:
A torque wrench should be stored:
options: At its lowest setting after use

lessons.title: Customer Communication Basics
lessons.summary: Turning a diagnostic report into something a customer actually understands and trusts.

questions.prompt: When explaining a repair to a customer, it is best to:
options: Use as much technical jargon as possible
Explain the problem, the fix, and the value in plain language

questions.prompt: Building customer trust is most helped by:
options: Transparency about what was found and why it matters
